# CLI: Backup

## get-policy

Kind: Read.

Reads one policy in `hcm-3` or `han-1`. `--project-id` has no effect. Hourly,
weekly, and monthly schedule details are omitted.

| Flag          | Type     | Required |
| ------------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--policy-id` | `string` | yes      |

```sh
greennode backup get-policy --policy-id <policy-id> --query Policy
```

## list-backends

Kind: Read.

Reads token-scoped backends in `hcm-3` or `han-1`.

No fields.

```sh
greennode backup list-backends
```

## list-policies

Kind: Read.

Reads one token-scoped page in `hcm-3` or `han-1`. `--page` defaults to 1 and
`--size` defaults to 200.

The output includes cadence enable flags and daily schedule settings.

| Flag     | Type  | Required |
| -------- | ----- | -------- |
| `--page` | `int` |          |
| `--size` | `int` |          |

```sh
greennode backup list-policies \
  --query 'Items[].{ID:ID,Name:Name,Default:IsDefault}' --output table
```
